maria: Quick perf heads-up: saw a 12-18% p95/p99 latency regression on AWQ weight-only int8 after the recent packing change when group_size <= 16. KV cache eviction + small batches amplify it. Posting profiling snippets and bench numbers.

maria: bench command we used:
```
bench --model redwood/falcon-7b --quant awq --group 8 --pack true --batch 1 --seq 64 --run 1000
```
observed: p99 130ms -> 146ms (+12.3%), tokens/s 820 -> 750 (-8.5%). logs: s3://redwood-perf/awq/pack-evict/1903456789/

liam: Is this AWQ-only or does GPTQ show the same regression?

maria: Primarily AWQ. Ran the same pack path with GPTQ weights and saw ~2-3% variance (within noise). Profiling shows extra memcpy on the KV hotpath for AWQ small-group codepath. Flame shows serial unpack loop taking +18% cycles.

akshay: Could be packing alignment + cacheline eviction. Did you try forcing the fused pack kernel? You can set the runtime hint: `RW_KERNEL_PREF=fused_pack` for a quick check. /cc @rachel for calibration side-effects.

rachel: Also seen calibration drift when group < 16 — quant stat variance can flip kernel branches during kernel selection. Try using larger per-group calibration samples or enable group aggregation. Example config we've been testing:
```
quant_config:
  group_size: 8
  calibration_samples: 5000
  group_aggregate: true
```
That reduced kernel-chooser churn in my local runs.

perf-ci-bot: :exclamation: CI regression alert: perf/job/awq-int8-pack on canary failed p95 SLA. Build: canary-20260318-42. Details: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/awq-int8-pack/42

liam: Also check batching heuristics — small batch sizes increase packing frequency and KV thrash. Can you try `batch_size=4` with continuous batching enabled (keep-alive batching) to see if it amortizes pack cost?

maria: Ran batch=4 with continuous batching on the same model: p99 improved to ~136ms (vs 146) and tokens/s = 790. So still slightly worse than baseline but much better than batch=1. KV eviction rate dropped: `evict_rate: 0.12 -> 0.03`. Full run logs in /tmp/pack-evict-logs-1903456789.tar.gz.

akshay: If fused kernel removes the memcpy overhead, we should prefer it for AWQ small groups. Proposal: add a kernel-pref rule: `prefer_fused` when group_size <= 16 AND batch <= 4, fallback to serial otherwise. I'll draft a patch to kernel-selector with a fast path.

infra-bot: Scheduling canary rollout for kernel-pref rule. Canary ID: canary-20260318-7. Target slot: next maintenance window. @maria @akshay please monitor.

rachel: :thumbsup: also add a focused eval checkpoint linked to the canary to catch any quality drift from AWQ group aggregation change.

maria: Thanks — I'll attach the eval prompts and a small regression harness to the canary ticket.

liam: Good iterative plan. Once we have canary telemetry, we can decide whether to make fused-pref default for AWQ small-group workloads.
